name: How long does it take to replace a toilet during a bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to replace a toilet during a bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typically, replacing a standard toilet takes approximately 2 to 4 hours. This timeframe can vary based on whether new plumbing lines or floor modifications are required, or if the new toilet has different rough-in dimensions than the old one. If the remodel involves significant changes to the bathroom layout, the overall project duration will be longer. Alpha-Plumbing Services aims for efficient installations to minimize disruption to your remodel timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard toilet replacement usually takes 2-4 hours, but can vary with plumbing adjustments or floor modifications.
